There is no evidence of top-level code that would execute harmful commands (such as `curl | bash`, `eval`, or data exfiltration) when the file is sourced. While the source URLs point to GitHub and raw.githubusercontent.com, these are expected upstream locations for the package's own artifacts and license file. No obfuscated code, dynamic evaluation, or suspicious process substitutions appear in the global scope. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for `--printsrcinfo` poses no immediate risk.
</details>
